name: invalid_resume_seq_after_snapshot
comment: review F5-06b: SwmrResetReason.invalid_resume_seq has schema and code but no prior vector reached it. A snapshot then a delta bring head=1; a probe read with a cursor past head (seq=99, a position that never existed -- always a client bug, the engine is authoritative on seq) -> state=reset, reset_reason=invalid_resume_seq, with a fresh snapshot+tail attached, next_cursor=head=1
